reviewer: Project author, after the browser verdict. This is a reading of the attempts, not another test.
summary: All three proposals were rejected at the third Escape press. Nemotron attributed the failure to the modal flag or to the event wrapper; it never found the actual cause.
caveats: Escape is not user activation, so after the first press Chromium fires cancel with cancelable=false and preventDefault() has no effect.
Pending pull request #43077 cancels the Escape keydown instead, which keeps the close request from being sent; it passes this task.
The frozen task reported the step and the dialog state, but nothing in the evidence shows that cancel was not cancelable. Exposing that would be an engine change, not a retry.
